_doc: MultiDimension-Localization dataset (NetManAIOps). 21 microservices, 19 metrics per service (399 time series), 58 anomaly cases. The high-dimensional service-graph validator: expected motifs depend on which root-cause category each of the 58 cases belongs to. Window ranges and per-case motif assignments TBD until upstream extraction.

_template_per_case.narrative: Template entry; populate one block per anomaly case (1..58) when the upstream archive is extracted. Each case carries its own root-cause category which determines the expected MotifClass.
